text:
sara: Quick heads-up — we're starting onboarding for gulliver-7b (repo: https://huggingface.co/org/gulliver-7b). The LICENSE looks restrictive: mentions non-commercial use and has a clause about redistribution of modified weights. Need legal on three things: hosted API permissibility, shipping quantized weights to Dedicated/Private customers, and required attribution text. Ping @maria

jordan: Link to license: https://huggingface.co/org/gulliver-7b/blob/main/LICENSE. Relevant excerpt: 'For non-commercial use only. Redistribution of modified model weights prohibited.' Not ideal.

maria: Hey — maria (legal). Based on that excerpt, immediate red flags: (a) non-commercial clause may prevent commercial hosting, (b) redistribution prohibition likely blocks us from shipping quantized weights to customers. However "service" vs "distribution" distinction matters — some licenses allow providing inference as a service. I'll escalate to counsel for a definitive interpretation. For now, treat as "hosted-only possible, redistribution blocked" until we have a ruling.

eli: From ML: we intended to produce two deliverables — q4 quantized weights + a conversion script. If redistribution is blocked we can still run the model in our hosted infra. For Dedicated customers we sometimes hand over weights for on-prem hosting; we should freeze that flow. Quick technical note: we can offer a "run-in-customer-vpc" option where we deploy into their VPC without handing over files. Is that acceptable org-wise?

sara: Good point. Can we offer "no-weights" Dedicated: we run the container in customer's VPC but never transfer weight files to them? Also, license sometimes requires attribution — does that need to appear in product UI or docs?

maria: Attribution: if license mandates it, we must surface the attribution in our product docs and in the model catalog page; ideally also in per-customer legal notices. Redistribution clause: if it explicitly prohibits distributing modified weights, shipping quantized weights = distribution. Distributing a script that users run locally might be safer, but counsel will confirm. For now: DO NOT prepare any downloadable quantized weights for distribution to customers.

eli: Understood. For evals: I'll run quant experiments locally (q4/q8, per-token perf and perplexity / instruct evals) and post a short comparison against redwood-base. That should help product decide if hosting is worthwhile even with restrictions. Small ask: can I get a staging account to run hosted-only smoke tests after legal sign-off?

jordan: I'll capture provenance (commit hash, dataset license, author contact) in the onboarding doc and add the license text verbatim. Also adding a checkbox to the model-catalog metadata: hosted-only / weights-export-disabled.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: created ticket ML-427 "gulliver-7b license triage — hosted vs redistribution". Flagged as P1 for legal. Blockers: Dedicated weight export flow.

sara: Action items: (1) @maria escalate to counsel and confirm if "inference-as-a-service" is allowed and whether attribution string is required in UI; (2) @eli run quant evals and post results + delta vs redwood-base; (3) @jordan lock provenance and mark model as hosted-only in catalog until cleared. Pausing any weight distribution work for Dedicated/Private until legal okays.

maria: Will escalate today, ETA EOD + 2 business days. Please avoid creating any customer-facing weight artifacts until we have confirmation. :white_check_mark:
